name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
title: Illuga: Elk With Fanged Antlers
in_play_description: While your Illuga with this card equipped is on the field: For every 2 stacks of Nightingale's Song consumed, create 1 Aedon to your Hand. (Currently consumed: $[G16121] stack(s).)

attributes.source: Reward for inviting Illuga to a duel at The Cat's Tail and achieving all corresponding challenge objectives

skills.desc:
Fast Action: When your active character is Illuga, equip this card.
Create 1 stack of Nightingale's Song.
While your Illuga with this card equipped is on the field: For every 2 stacks of Nightingale's Song consumed, create 1 Aedon to your Hand.
(You must have Illuga in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
